hooks.name: supplaiguard-analyze-on-manifest-change
hooks.description: After a dependency manifest or AI-component config is saved, prompt a SupplAIGuard analysis.

action.prompt: A dependency manifest or AI-component config just changed. Run a SupplAIGuard analysis: delegate to supplaiguard-discovery then supplaiguard-threat-analysis (via the supplaiguard-coordinator), and report any new findings per the sg-findings-schema. Do not remediate without approval.
